course.title: Digital Literacy, Information Verification & Research Tools
course.credential_boundary: 3 internal Khaemenes learning units; not institutional college credits.

modules.title: Digital Systems & File Literacy
modules.essential: How devices, files, formats and storage affect reliable academic work.

lessons.title: Files, Folders and Naming
lessons.focus: Organize digital work with stable names, folders and versions.

lessons.title: Formats, Compatibility and Preservation
lessons.focus: Choose formats that support access, editing, printing and long-term readability.

lessons.title: Local, Cloud and Backup Models
lessons.focus: Distinguish working copies, backups, sync and archival storage.

modules.title: Search & Information Retrieval
modules.essential: How to formulate searches that find relevant, traceable sources.

lessons.title: Search Intent and Query Design
lessons.focus: Translate a research need into precise search terms and phrases.

lessons.title: Operators, Filters and Domain Search
lessons.focus: Use search operators and filters without assuming ranking equals quality.

lessons.title: Search Logs and Retrieval Trails
lessons.focus: Record what was searched, found, rejected and revisited.

modules.title: Source Verification
modules.essential: How to test the origin, context and reliability of online information.

lessons.title: Authorship, Publication and Provenance
lessons.focus: Identify who created a source, where it originated and whether it was altered.

lessons.title: Cross-Checking Claims
lessons.focus: Compare independent sources rather than relying on repetition.

lessons.title: Images, Screenshots and Context Loss
lessons.focus: Recognize cropped, recycled or decontextualized media.

modules.title: Misinformation, Manipulation & Scams
modules.essential: How deceptive design and social engineering exploit attention and trust.

lessons.title: Common Scam Patterns
lessons.focus: Recognize urgency, impersonation, payment pressure and credential theft.

lessons.title: Manipulative Interface Patterns
lessons.focus: Identify dark patterns, misleading buttons and consent pressure.

lessons.title: Rumors, Virality and Emotional Amplification
lessons.focus: Pause before sharing highly arousing or weakly sourced claims.

modules.title: Privacy, Security & Identity
modules.essential: How learners protect accounts, devices and personal information.

lessons.title: Passwords, Passphrases and Authentication
lessons.focus: Use unique credentials and multi-factor authentication where available.

lessons.title: Permissions, Tracking and Data Sharing
lessons.focus: Evaluate what apps and sites request access to.

lessons.title: Phishing, Links and Attachment Safety
lessons.focus: Inspect senders, destinations and unexpected files before acting.

modules.title: Digital Citizenship & Communication
modules.essential: How online behavior affects learning communities and public records.

lessons.title: Tone, Context and Audience Online
lessons.focus: Adapt communication to public, academic and private settings.

lessons.title: Boundaries, Harassment and Reporting
lessons.focus: Use blocking, reporting and documentation tools appropriately.

lessons.title: Permanent, Searchable and Shareable Records
lessons.focus: Understand that digital posts can persist beyond intended audiences.

modules.title: Accessible Digital Work
modules.essential: How to create documents and media that more people can use.

lessons.title: Readable Structure and Headings
lessons.focus: Use semantic headings, lists and descriptive labels.

lessons.title: Alt Text, Captions and Transcripts
lessons.focus: Provide text equivalents for visual and audio information.

lessons.title: Contrast, Keyboard Access and Simple Layout
lessons.focus: Avoid design choices that create unnecessary access barriers.

modules.title: Documents, Spreadsheets & Data Basics
modules.essential: How common productivity tools support academic and professional work.

lessons.title: Document Structure and Revision
lessons.focus: Use styles, comments and versioning for longer written work.

lessons.title: Spreadsheet Literacy
lessons.focus: Use rows, columns, formulas and validation without hiding assumptions.

lessons.title: Data Export and Interoperability
lessons.focus: Move information between formats while checking for loss or corruption.

modules.title: Research Tools & Reproducibility
modules.essential: How digital tools support transparent research rather than opaque automation.

lessons.title: Reference and Note Systems
lessons.focus: Organize citations, excerpts and notes so source ownership remains clear.

lessons.title: Version Control Concepts
lessons.focus: Understand revisions, diffs, rollback and change history.

lessons.title: Reproducible Research Packages
lessons.focus: Bundle sources, methods, data and outputs so another reviewer can inspect the work.

modules.title: AI & Automated Tools
modules.essential: How to use generative and automated systems without surrendering judgment or attribution.

lessons.title: AI as Assistant, Not Authority
lessons.focus: Treat generated output as a draft or hypothesis requiring verification.

lessons.title: Verification, Hallucination and Source Checking
lessons.focus: Check claims, calculations, citations and quotations independently.

lessons.title: Disclosure, Attribution and Academic Integrity
lessons.focus: Follow course rules for documenting meaningful automated assistance.

modules.title: Digital Workflows & Collaboration
modules.essential: How to coordinate shared work without losing ownership or accountability.

lessons.title: Roles, Permissions and Shared Folders
lessons.focus: Grant only the access collaborators need.

lessons.title: Comments, Tasks and Decision Records
lessons.focus: Preserve decisions, responsibilities and revision history.

lessons.title: Conflict, Merge and Handoff Practices
lessons.focus: Reconcile competing edits and leave a usable handoff record.

modules.title: Integrated Digital Research Practice
modules.essential: How to complete a secure, accessible and verifiable digital research project.

lessons.title: Research Workspace Design
lessons.focus: Create a folder, naming, backup and source-record system for a project.

lessons.title: Verification & Accessibility Audit
lessons.focus: Audit sources, privacy, accessibility and reproducibility before publication.

lessons.title: Capstone Digital Research Package
lessons.focus: Deliver a documented project package another reviewer can navigate and verify.

assessment.capstone: secure, accessible and reproducible digital research package
